## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

No interview questions asked — auto-complete path (decision: skip). Evidence-based findings verified from the worklog, git, and live test runs.

- Q: Is this test failure still reproducible at current HEAD?
  A: **No.** The pytest suite is PASSING (2984 passed, 17 skipped in 353s). The timeout was environmental/flaky.
  Answered by: Map (agent). Evidence: live test run at HEAD a3408159.

- Q: What caused the original 1800s timeout?
  A: The combined suite command (`pytest && node --test tests/unit/**/*.mjs && ...`) hangs on `tests/unit/test-check-audit-gate.mjs`, which calls live `checkAuditReadyToClose()` for work item SA-0MTOMCML900254CI. This is a known test hermeticity defect.
  Answered by: Map (agent). Evidence: individual test run showed `test-check-audit-gate.mjs` hangs indefinitely; `tests/node/` and `tests/cli/` pass.

- Q: Is there existing tracking for the root cause?
  A: Yes — SA-0MSRN0Q64005YR5A (stale pytest exit 1) already identified this hermeticity issue. A follow-up fix (making test-check-audit-gate.mjs hermetic) is recommended.
  Answered by: Map (agent). Reference: SA-0MSRN0Q64005YR5A plan comment.
